items.body:
Claude桌面新功能：生成内容可安装为应用

Anthropic宣布Claude推出 “安装为应用”功能测试版，允许用户将AI生成的Artifacts直接安装为Mac或Windows桌面应用，无需手动打包、签名，也无需单独申请API密钥。

安装后的应用拥有独立图标和运行窗口，用户无需在Claude对话界面内操作，即可像使用普通桌面软件一样打开应用。这些应用能够调用Claude模型以及用户已连接的外部服务，支持与他人共享，并在底层Artifacts内容被修改后自动更新。

目前，该功能正面向Claude所有订阅套餐用户逐步开放测试。这些应用仍需联网并登录Claude账号才能打开，调用Claude模型也将消耗用户现有套餐的使用额度。

—— 凤凰网科技

Anthropic四名骨干先后转向OpenAI，Claude Code三名离职成员或将重聚

长期追踪 AI 公司人员流动的匿名账号 Arfur Grok 爆料，Claude Code 前核心工程师 Thariq Shihipar 已加入 OpenAI。

Thariq 是 Claude Code 的核心工程师之一，曾参与 Claude Agent SDK 的开发，并推出 AskUserQuestion 工具，让 Claude 在执行复杂任务时主动向用户确认需求。他还经常公开分享 Claude Code 的底层设计和使用技巧，是团队在开发者社区最活跃的成员之一。他于 10 月 24 日宣布离开 Anthropic，当时表示准备先休息一阵，没有透露下一站。

与他同一天宣布离职的 Anthony Morris，曾创建 Claude Code 桌面版，也在 11 月 18 日被爆料加入 OpenAI。

11 月 5 日，Claude Code 产品负责人 Cat Wu 已亲自官宣加入 OpenAI，负责核心产品管理。同一天，Anthropic 首位增长营销员工 Austin Lau 也宣布加入 OpenAI。

Cat 当初宣布离职时，Thariq 还在评论区问她「部落还是联盟？」，借《魔兽世界》的阵营梗打趣。如今，两人可能真的成了同一阵营的队友。

—— 财联社

余承东：华为折叠手机中国市场份额已超70%

周三，华为常务董事、终端BG董事长余承东在社交平台发文称，2026年华为折叠屏手机在中国市场的份额已经超过70%。当天，华为发布新一代大折叠手机Mate X8。

—— 凤凰网科技

items.title: We’re launching Humanity’s First Exam and a Kaggle hackathon to test LLM reliability.
items.summary: Google launches Humanity’s First Exam to test LLM reliability across 544 prompts.
items.body:
We’re launching Humanity’s First Exam and a Kaggle hackathon to test LLM reliability.

Oran Kelly

Research Scientist, Google DeepMind

Nov 24, 2026

Today, we’re launching the Humanity’s First Exam (HFE) benchmark on Kaggle to measure how reliably LLMs answer straightforward, everyday questions. Current frontier models excel at complex math, coding, and science, with most benchmarks measuring these domain-specific capability ceilings.

Instead of focusing on whether a model is capable of solving a task once, HFE measures whether models can consistently solve tasks (and slight variations) every single time. The dataset consists of 544 elementary text and image prompts across 20 foundational capabilities. Over the last 6 months, frontier models have made significant progress on HFE.

Explore the live leaderboard, or read our technical report.

To keep the HFE benchmark dataset up to date, we’re inviting the community to help. Join our three-week Kaggle competition through December 15 and submit everyday questions that today’s models still get wrong.

Example prompt from Humanity’s First Exam’s public dataset: “List the color of the third letter of each word in the neon sign in order, separated by a semicolon.” (Answer: green; yellow; white; blue; blue)

items.body:
How Gemini is changing the game for Golden State's organization and fans.

Nov 24, 2026

Today, we’re expanding our partnership with Golden State — making Google Gemini the Official AI Assistant Partner and Official Generative AI & Enterprise LLM Partner of the Warriors, the 2026 WNBA Champion Valkyries, and Chase Center.

The collaboration integrates Gemini across the entire franchise ecosystem. For fans, that means a more interactive game-day experience, both inside Chase Center via interactive videoboard features, and across digital channels for fans following from home. And behind the scenes, Golden State is deploying Gemini for business to build custom AI agents, helping their teams work smarter across both business and basketball operations.

As a Founding Partner of Chase Center since 2019, Golden State has used our gen AI tools to help their operations run smoother, and this next chapter brings the best of Gemini to the team and fans alike.
